name: Quoted SOW (prepaid + T&M)
comment: Same section structure as the default set but Commercials is mandatory and must carry a generated quote: planned scope priced at the sell rates, netting off whatever the customer's prepaid/fixed arrangements still cover. Template and style files are shared with the default set (see manifest).

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.guidance: One to two paragraphs: who the customer is, what is being delivered, why now, and the headline outcome. No pricing detail here.

sections.title: Background
sections.guidance: Business context and the problem being solved, grounded in the source material. Name the systems, teams and constraints that matter.

sections.title: Scope
sections.guidance: Bullet list of in-scope workstreams. Each bullet starts with a verb. Scope items must trace to the source material or be flagged.

sections.title: Out of Scope
sections.guidance: Explicit exclusions that prevent scope disputes. If the source is silent, propose standard exclusions and flag them for review.

sections.title: Deliverables
sections.guidance: Concrete artefacts with acceptance owners. Each deliverable maps to one or more delivery phases (Requirements, Data Sourcing, Data Engineering, Data Science, Tableau, UAT).

sections.title: Assumptions & Dependencies
sections.guidance: Numbered assumptions (access, data quality, availability) and external dependencies. These seed the project's assumptions register.

sections.title: Timeline & Milestones
sections.guidance: Milestones expressed against the 5-week sprint cadence (4 dev + 1 hardening). Dates are indicative until sprint allocation is confirmed.

sections.title: Commercials
sections.guidance: MANDATORY in this template. Carries the generated quote: per-skill scope in story points priced at the agreed sell rates, with any portion covered by the customer's prepaid/fixed arrangements explicitly netted off and labelled. State the currency, tax treatment and price-validity window. Never hand-write figures — the quote is generated from project sizing, the rate card and the live prepaid balances.

sections.title: Roles & Responsibilities
sections.guidance: Delivery-side and customer-side roles with their responsibilities. Use role archetypes (matching personas) rather than named individuals unless the source names them.

sections.title: Acceptance Criteria
sections.guidance: Measurable conditions for acceptance per deliverable, plus the review window and sign-off mechanism.

sections.title: Sign-off
sections.guidance: Signature block for both parties: name, role, date. No content beyond the block and any validity period.

deliverables.rule: Every deliverable carries a phases array drawn from valid_phases; the union of phases becomes the project's delivery_config.phase_order candidate.

assumptions_dependencies.rule: Each numbered assumption becomes one assumptions_register entry on the linked project.

timeline_milestones.rule: Milestones reference sprint ids where known; otherwise they remain indicative dates and are flagged.

commercials.rule: The SOW stores the structured quote (per-skill points, prepaid coverage, rates, totals, currency) generated by Billing.quoteForProject for the linked project; the section text renders it.
